mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital for corporations and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate indicates a tightening monetary policy during a strong labor market, which typically leads to a recessionary risk and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low housing starts (HOUST below 1500 thousand units), the demand for residential construction is weak, signaling a slowdown in the broader economy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC for the HOUST signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of weak retail sales (RSAFS below 360,000 million dollars), consumer spending is contracting, which signals a slowdown in the economy and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 360000, or the Rank IC for the RSAFS signal is below 0.03.
